methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia Tech adopts universitywide human-centered AI vision - EdTech Innovation Hub
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's universitywide human-centered AI vision signals potential for deep, distributed capability development through the institution's statewide Extension network and research partnerships, creating knowledge infrastructure beyond NoVA if implementation reaches underserved regions.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops designed to 'close the technology gap' in Hampton Roads represent grassroots distributed learning infrastructure, signaling community-driven capability building that could counteract concentration if sustained beyond individual initiatives.

signals.title: How one Virginia county’s AI platform protects sensitive data - Route Fifty
signals.signal_reading: A Virginia county deploying its own AI platform for sensitive data protection demonstrates deep technical capability but likely concentrated in well-resourced NoVA jurisdictions with IT budgets and talent pools unavailable to rural counties.

signals.title: A(I)ttorney: Va. law schools integrate AI tools to train next-gen lawyers - Virginia Lawyers Weekly
signals.signal_reading: Law schools statewide integrating AI tools into legal training creates professional fluency across Virginia's distributed legal education system, potentially democratizing AI literacy in a high-value profession beyond tech hubs if access spans UVA, W&M, Richmond, and Regent.

signals.title: Camp Welcomes Hampton Roads Youth to Learn About Cybersecurity and AI - Old Dominion University
signals.signal_reading: Youth-focused cybersecurity and AI camps at Old Dominion University build early-stage distributed capability in Hampton Roads' defense tech corridor, creating regional talent pipelines that could deepen non-NoVA AI ecosystems if connected to local career pathways.
